assertion_analysis.fails_if: Review precedence, priority or FIFO changes; listing count exceeds one; project filtering, first ambiguous match or complete-id resolution changes. Expected identities are constructed independently in the fixture.
Non-review or complete-id cohort loses rows or starts listing; the populated fixture is the positive control for no listing.
Population leaks across passes or retired source retains review priority; restoring per-request reads yields 42 calls rather than two.
An unrelated review defers the target or the deferral scan repeats listings; base yields 21 calls.
Empty supplied population is treated as absent and re-listed, or durable fallback is skipped. The fallback-value assertion checks a stub contract; independent calls assertion guards no relisting.
Empty list resets lazy initialization, causing repeated listings, or queue loses requests.
Listing exception aborts ordering, retries per request, or prevents five complete-id reviews from retaining priority.

evidence_notes: Read exact git objects: assigned tree HEAD f66f15c99323678ef5aa673480ad5f037ac85b92 differs from reviewed head.
Base negative control used an earlier six-case test file; final eight-case head file was read independently.

Importer logs independently show baseline 9 failed/383 passed/1 error and head 8 failed/384 passed/1 error, with no added IDs; added_failure_count derives from the clean armed baseline_suite and after_suite pair.
No source or tests changed; no suite rerun.
